      • deployProcess

        protected void deployProcess​(@NotNull
                             @NotNull ReleaseChangeProcess process)
                      throws InterruptedException
        Make sure ReleaseChangeProcess#run() is called later. If it's currently running, we queue it so that it'll run after the current run is finished - compare ReleaseChangeEventPublisherImpl.RescheduleWrapper.run(). We rather call run once too many - it is contractually obliged to do nothing if it hasn't anything to do.
        Throws:
        InterruptedException

      • compareTree

        public void compareTree​(@NotNull
                        @NotNull com.composum.sling.core.ResourceHandle resource,
                        int details,
                        @Nullable
                        @Nullable String[] processIdParams,
                        @NotNull
                        @NotNull Map<String,​? super ReleaseChangeEventPublisher.CompareResult> output)
                 throws ReplicationException
        Description copied from interface: ReleaseChangeEventPublisher
        Compares the contents of the whole release root or subtree at {resource}.
        Specified by:
        compareTree in interface ReleaseChangeEventPublisher
        Parameters:
        resource - a release root or a subnode of it
        details - If 0, only difference counts are returned. If 1, the different paths are included. For some replication types higher values switch on further checks.
        processIdParams - if set, comparisons are only done for the ReleaseChangeProcess with the given ReleaseChangeProcess.getId().
        output - the result is added here: the ReleaseChangeProcess.getId() is mapped to the corresponding ReleaseChangeEventPublisher.CompareResult.
        Throws:
        ReplicationException
